part.text:
The robot is now in front of the green panel at the end of the corridor, about 0.7 m away. I called rest, and it is crouched with the motors off.

The corridor ran straight, then turned left, then ran straight again to the panel. The last camera image shows the panel filling the view. The robot is angled slightly to the left of it, because its heading drifted a little (about 8°) when it crouched.
